question: Is a proposal whose line nulls none of its own preview items shown to the user at all, given a line named from one item nulled 0 of its 11 slice items?
answer: No: a proposal is shown only when its line, by the two-run rule, nulls at least half of the preview items that scored a priority without it; otherwise the line is named once more with the preview items as further examples, and the candidate is dropped (and logged) if it still falls short.
